entries.text: The compiler is correct (the pinned msvcmodel GCC and the pinned toolchain).
SHA-256 is collision resistant and preimage resistant (cache keys, fact hashes).
Win32 and D3D9 behave as documented (no formal model); the declared machine answers as Wine 9.0 / Windows document.
The console's behaviour holds as assumed until a run on it.

decision.quote: 4. the console's behaviour until a run on it;

entries.text: Native code is tested by ASan/UBSan, not proven; external libraries (libc, libnx, FreeType, minimp3) are taken by their documentation.

decision.quote: 5. native code is tested by ASan/UBSan, not proven;

entries.text: The exe makes no wild accesses: array indices are in bounds, guest accesses do not reach host pages.

decision.quote: 6. the exe makes no wild accesses (array indices in bounds);

entries.text: The address space is 32-bit, ILP32.
Floating point is IEEE binary32/binary64.
The pinned formal tools and published theorems are correct: the Sail CPU model at its pinned patch, isla and z3, the published proof of the x86-TSO to Arm memory mapping.

decision.quote: 9. the pinned formal tools and published theorems are correct: the Sail CPU model at its pinned patch, isla and z3,
